'''Merl Tosche''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] and the founder of [[Tosche Station/Legends|Tosche Station]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], near the town of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]]. He rarely visited and thus the Tosche Station was supervised by [[Laze Loneozner/Legends|Laze Loneozner]], who spent most of his time there. At his shop he sold parts for farming such as [[Power converter/Legends|power converters]].
